summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the 7 residual terminology hits from iteration 251 on an agency tenant in Spanish. Recreated demo terminology_v6@kora.com (industry_type=agency, modules program_orchestration + demand_studio), promoted 3 seeded projects to stage=Committed, forced 1 to stage=Closed in Mongo, and set 2 projects to the same date to trigger the calendar conflict banner. VERDICT: all 7 hits are FIXED and render 'Proyecto/proyecto' correctly. HOWEVER I first found and fixed a blocking no-undef bug: ProductionAssetsTab.js imported useTerminology but never destructured `term`, so the 'Vincular a Inventario' dialog would have thrown a ReferenceError (same mistake pattern as iteration 251). After that 1-line fix, hit (e) renders correctly. Demo account fully deleted at the end.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY ME (in-scope no-undef crash): `term(...)` used at lines 595-596 without `const { term } = useTerminology();` -> ReferenceError would blank the Production Assets tab as soon as the link dialog rendered. Added the destructure. Main agent: add an eslint no-undef gate to this refactor workflow, this is the 4th file with the same mistake.

Residual hardcoded English/event string in the error toast: 'Error al cargar Event Binder' / 'Failed to load Event Binder' — should use term('events','entity_singular'). Not visible in the happy path (only on fetch failure).

STILL VISIBLE for agency tenants (Documentos > Packing List / Montaje sub-tab): 'Reserva inventario para este evento desde el menú/receta o desde Gestión de Recursos → Compras.' Confirmed rendered on screen for the agency project, so the earlier assumption that this file is culinary-only/not reachable is incorrect.

issues: Offers culinary-specific documents to an agency tenant: 'Hoja de Cocina — Recetas y preparación para cocina', 'Menú — Menú del proyecto para imprimir', 'Lista de Montaje — Equipos, servicio, decoración - NO comida'. Irrelevant for agency/consulting industries; these cards should be gated by industry/modules.
